name: ai-token-saver
description: Recommend the lowest-cost suitable available OpenAI model and effort from a live guide, with a Revision citation. Guidance updates on use.

interface.longDescription: Get a model and effort recommendation from the live Model Value Map. Start with the cheapest suitable listed pick, verify the result and upgrade only after a failed check. Guidance refreshes when used. Optional setup adds the guidance to your instructions and one task that refreshes it every two weeks. Savings depend on the task and are not guaranteed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Recommend a model and effort for my task using current guidance. Cite the Revision.
